Starting with an existing Woo shop

Use the WooCommerce setup for the original SF104 plugin and seller/delivery connection. Install its CoCart profile companion, save the actual simple virtual product and payment mapping, then choose Download saved headless profile on that product.

The local preparation tool copies the companion from your selected installed source. It includes the native application and managed-operation guides.

Named handoffs and additional receiving files

The merchant connection can expose original host files under explicit aliases. The native application attaches a handoff to its actual cart preview when the operator selects that action.

Use an explicitly received local Woo instance

For profile creation, import the original transport JSON with store_url, checkout_url and reason. It selects the actual loopback receiver while preserving the merchant profile. Rebind a received existing workspace from its own native application.

Select the operator’s host paths.

The installed tools use these exact private paths. Create or receive one customer directory, then open it in the original application or managed Applications.

Use its real parent. A new receiving directory is empty; existing customer work stays in its original directory.

For a separately retained package, select its absolute dist/index.js. The native reader checks SDK 1.2.1.

Choose a connection to expose the same workspace and named original files to the merchant agent. Its parent is an operator-owned mode-0700 directory.

Review the exact setup.

The packet preserves every imported byte. Native inspection on the selected host checks the full original profile, handoff and receiving-object closure before setup.

Choose the original source and host settings to review this packet.

Run the customer workflow.

Extract the packet and select the maintained toolkit. The original application keeps each native operation, cart snapshot, checkout preview and Woo handoff in the same customer workspace.

Use the installed Applications page

Select CoCart customer workspace. Enter the customer directory, SDK and optional connection shown below. Review, Save, Review start, Start and Open. The manager verifies the actual live instance before opening it.

Use that manager’s Stop action, then reopen and review the saved application. Its customer history and native order remain in the original directory.

Cart and checkout

Load the real catalog, create or reopen a guest cart, and apply reviewed changes. Select Replace or Merge checkout. The current profile compares one mapped simple virtual product at quantity one with the merchant’s saved total and Stellar terms.

Order and receiving

Complete native Woo checkout and attach its original handoff to the same preview. Continue through the existing buyer and delivery tools. Export the complete customer JSON, then reopen that exact file on the receiving host.

Operating handover

Record the store owner, product, source/SDK, order/attempt and support contact. Confirm the selected workflow, retain the export, Stop and reopen before handing the installation to its operator.
